meta.name: ai-copywriting
meta.description: 文案诊断助手适合内容创作者、市场营销、运营、内容媒体在用户提出“这段文案能打动人吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成说服力诊断、可复制改稿、风险词提示。

copy.tagline: 诊断文案说服力并给出改稿建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常写文案但不确定效果，需要快速获得改进建议。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose copy persuasiveness and provide rewrite suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write copy but are unsure of its impact and need quick improvement suggestions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，当你提供文案或内容目标，它会分析文案的说服力、给出可复制的修改建议，并提示可能的风险词。
howto.when: 当你问“这段文案能打动人吗”或需要优化文案、准备发布内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这段产品文案能不能打动目标用户？
say.note: 它会分析说服力并给出改稿建议。

say.text: 我写了一篇公众号推文，帮我检查有没有风险词。
say.note: 它会提示需要修改的敏感词汇。

say.text: 针对年轻妈妈群体，优化这段促销文案。
say.note: 它会结合受众给出针对性改稿。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you provide copy or content goals, it analyzes persuasiveness, gives editable rewrite suggestions, and flags risky words.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask 'Is this copy persuasive?' or need copy optimization or publication preparation.

say_en.text: Check if this product copy can appeal to target users.
say_en.note: It will analyze persuasiveness and suggest rewrites.

say_en.text: I wrote a WeChat article, check for risky words.
say_en.note: It will flag sensitive terms to revise.

say_en.text: Optimize this promotional copy for young mothers.
say_en.note: It will tailor rewrites for the audience.
